description: Three distinct strips: configurable filters, activities, activity-specific topics. Price median is derived from published menus and cached by menu version and selected price categories. No transactional pricing or authored content changed.

strips.filters: Independent grey chips with navy/white selection, configurable labels/order/enabled/thresholds
strips.activities: Only All and activity selectors; existing appearance retained
strips.topics: Only cuisine/brand selectors compatible with selected activity; circular image and caption

adminControls.activitiesTopics: pages/home-layout.html → شريطا الأنشطة والتصنيفات; separate editor groups
adminControls.priceMainCategories: تصنيفات الطعام والعلامات → ربط المطعم → أقسام الأصناف الرئيسية لمؤشر السعر

semantics.combination: Activity AND topic AND all selected filter conditions. Selecting a new activity clears topic but retains filters. All filter clears filters/sort only.
semantics.openNow: Fresh canonical timezone-aware status polling isAvailableNow; no guessed open state from isActive alone
semantics.fastDelivery: Canonical route arrivalMinutes.maximum includes preparation and road travel; missing estimate never classifies as fast
semantics.price: Median positive base product prices in customer-visible published menu; optional category whitelist from merchant classification; at least 3 samples by default; promotions and extras excluded. Existing legacy-live-menu fallback is retained only for branches with no published menu, matching customer catalog policy.
semantics.unknown: Unknown/stale availability, ETA, prices or rating do not satisfy corresponding filter

priceIndex.invalidation: Published menu version and configured category selector hash; source version verified before cache read; legacy-live TTL 5 min, published TTL 1 hour
priceIndex.queries: Only bounded requested merchants on explicit price filter. Published menu Query or existing legacy live-table Query; no full-table scan or per-screen recomputation of menu prices

humanAcceptance: Configure activities and topics separately, assign matching branches, publish home
Choose restaurant then pizza and offers; switch to store and verify topic resets
Set arrival threshold and compare against real destination-specific ETA
Choose a price tier and compare published menu index; change price-category whitelist and verify cache invalidates
Third strip renders when eligible topics have been configured and published; no invented taxonomy assignments
